title: KV Admission: Learning What to Write for Efficient Long-Context LLM Inference
abstract: arXiv:2512.17452v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Long-context LLM inference is bottlenecked by the quadratic attention complexity and linear Key-Value (KV) cache growth. Prior approaches mitigate this via post-hoc selection or eviction but overlook the root inefficiency: indiscriminate token admission. In this paper, we formalize KV management as a causal system of three primitives: KV Admission, Selection, and Eviction. We instantiate KV Admission via Write-Gated KV (WG-KV), a lightweight mechanism that learns to predict token utility before cache entry. By filtering out redundant states early to maintain a compact global cache alongside a sliding local cache, WG-KV significantly reduces memory usage and accelerates both prefill and decode phases. Our results demonstrate that learning what to write is a principled and practical recipe for efficient long-context inference. Code is available at https://github.com/EMCLab-Sinica/WG-KV.

translated_title: KV准入：学习写入什么以实现高效的长上下文LLM推理
translated_abstract: 长上下文LLM推理受到二次方注意力复杂度和线性键值缓存增长的瓶颈制约。先前的方法通过事后选择或驱逐来缓解这一问题，但忽视了根本的低效之处：不加区分的token准入。在本文中，我们将KV管理形式化为一个由三个原语组成的因果系统：KV准入、选择和驱逐。我们通过写入门控KV（WG-KV）来实现KV准入，这是一种轻量级机制，能够在token进入缓存之前学习预测其效用。通过提前过滤冗余状态以维护一个紧凑的全局缓存和滑动本地缓存，WG-KV显著减少了内存使用并加速了预填充和解码阶段。我们的结果表明，学习写入什么内容是实现高效长上下文推理的一种有原则且实用的方法。代码可在 https://github.com/EMCLab-Sinica/WG-KV 获取。
tldr: 该论文提出将KV缓存管理形式化为准入、选择和驱逐三个原语组成的因果系统，并通过轻量级的写入门控KV（WG-KV）机制在token进入缓存前预测其效用，从而提前过滤冗余状态、显著降低内存占用并加速长上下文LLM推理的预填充和解码阶段。
en_tdlr: This paper formalizes KV cache management as a causal system of three primitives (Admission, Selection, and Eviction) and proposes Write-Gated KV (WG-KV), a lightweight mechanism that learns to predict token utility before cache entry, significantly reducing memory usage and accelerating both prefill and decode phases for efficient long-context LLM inference.
